1479-2375-2841-8337.easyPrerequisites:
You're able to play a land this turn.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Riveteers Overlook.
1479-2375-2841-8337.description:
Fetch a land using Riveteers Overlook.
When the fetched land enters, M'Ress and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and M'Ress trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

539-3821-4050-4679-6821.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-3821-4050-4679-6821.description:
Cause Peregrine Drake to become an enchantment using Jump Scare.
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

1385-1957-4050--173.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature castable for {0}, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2060-2946-6701-8095.notablePrerequisites: You've had a non-Skeleton creature die under your control this turn.
2060-2946-6701-8095.description:
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
2060-2946-6701-8095.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

4871-5220-7806-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-7806-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

5170-6132-6495-7574.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sultai Flayer triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sultai Flayer trigger.
Resolve the Sultai Flayer trigger, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.

2738-4871-5686-6887.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, The Skullspore Nexus, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1308-4365-4772-6664-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

670-745-1603-1619.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-745-1603-1619.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Mirrorhall Mimic and Evil Twin each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-745-1603-1619.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

3457-5711-7791.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
3457-5711-7791.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Fanatic of Rhonas.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Fanatic of Rhonas.
Repeat.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

2178-4147-4294-5256.easyPrerequisites:
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
2178-4147-4294-5256.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R} and paying any commander tax if relevant.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Etali.
If Etali is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Etali dies, Hua Tuo triggers, untapping Hua Tuo.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from Step 3.
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library.
Cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from Step 2.

1849-3259-7279.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Razorkin Hordecaller triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

955-2366-4974-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
955-2366-4974-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer token enters, it triggers, creating a Mutavault land token that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault token enters, Springheart Nantuko, Amulet of Vigor and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the Mutavault token.
Holding priority, activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

3532-3594-5060-5078.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
3532-3594-5060-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3375-3532-5078-6604.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Clinquant Skymage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1978-2734-6893.description:
Animate The Eternity Elevator using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat from step 2.
1978-2734-6893.notes: If The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it, you can instead use its second ability to get infinite colored mana. You can also use both interchangeably, if desired.

224-654-1671-3314-3430.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using three in any combination of {G} and/or {U}, and have the mana to cast it.
224-654-1671-3314-3430.description:
Cast the creature in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it, Amulet of Vigor and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from your hand to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Chulane.
Resolve the creature spell cast in step 1.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning the creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1921-2905-4659.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Pestermite from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Pestermite token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Pestermite token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Pestermite token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Pestermite token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.

Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, creating a copy of it for each spell cast before it this turn.
If you created copies of Haze of Rage this way, Sedgemoor Witch triggers for each copy, creating that many 1/1 Pest creature tokens.
Resolve all Haze of Rage spells.
Repeat.

856-2279-3899-4321.description:

Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.

Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Reveillark.
When Reveillark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian and up to one other creature with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.

Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Naru Meha and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1274-1545-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.

Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1477-2558-5123-5687.notablePrerequisites: You control no more than two additional creatures.

When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Jetmir, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1857-2178-4395.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1857-2178-4395.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2034-2104-2493-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
2034-2104-2493-5131.description:
Cast Archaeomancer from your graveyard by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Archaeomancer, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

313-2034-2792.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}.
313-2034-2792.description:
Activate up to fiva mana producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Great Whale, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Great Whale enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}.
Repeat.

1283-1987-3075-4125.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1283-1987-3075-4125.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.
